summary: std/crypto: the RSA private key operation and decryption's padding checks, X25519, P-256/P-384/P-521 key generation, ECDH and ECDSA signing, Ed25519 keys and signing, and ML-KEM run with Arm's DIT bit set...
details: the RSA private key operation and decryption's padding checks, X25519, P-256/P-384/P-521 key generation, ECDH and ECDSA signing, Ed25519 keys and signing, and ML-KEM run with Arm's DIT bit set (decision 0619), as Go 1.24's crypto does. A test binary built at LLVM's -O0 checked PKCS #1 v1.5 padding in a time that followed the data on Apple silicon (dudect |t| 81, no branch in the code); with DIT every class pair passes (max |t| 3.8 at -O0, 1.9 native, 3.1 at -O2). CPUs without FEAT_DIT, x86-64 and wasm are unchanged.
